description: Search scholarly papers by keywords. Returns title, authors, year, venue, citation count, DOI and a free to read link when one exists. Inputs: query (required keywords), from_year (optional earliest publication year), open_access_only (optional, false by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'find open access papers on spaced repetition since 2020.'

from_year.description: Only papers published in or after this year.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25.

open_access_only.description: Only papers with a free to read copy.

query.description: Keywords, for example: spaced repetition exam performance.

name: search_papers
title: Search papers
